decisions.reason: As a core garage-door operator line with several models and a visible standalone presentation, it embodies sunk development and public commitment that management is likely to continue backing.

The solid wood sectional door is a more niche and less prominently committed offering, but it still fits the firm's garage-door range closely enough that management would tend to give it further time rather than exit quickly.

Because this operator variant overlaps with the broader operator range and appears less central and less visibly committed than Product A, management is now more likely to rationalize it and redirect resources after several years.
Its insulated glazed industrial design matches the firm's compliance- and performance-led positioning, so prior investment and strategic fit support continued commitment.
With its own webpage and strong fit with the firm's industrial sectional-door competence, this product carries high visible commitment and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
